title: recipe book
overall_deck_description: Designed as a modern culinary recipe deck, the presentation pairs a vibrant coral-red accent with crisp white backgrounds and rich, natural ingredient photography (fresh produce, rustic cutting boards, and vibrant greens). Typography relies on a heavy, rounded sans-serif for high-impact headlines and a clean, understated sans-serif in slate grey for recipe details. The sequence opens with a minimalist framed coral badge cover (Slide 0), transitions through photo-driven and multi-column recipe body layouts incorporating dynamic image collages and section headers, and concludes with an asymmetric split-screen contact slide (Slide 7) balancing left-aligned coral text with a full-bleed produce photograph.
